name: ctxport
description: Copy AI conversations as clean Markdown Context Bundles — one click from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok & GitHub. Copy from sidebar without opening. Zero upload, 100% local, open source.
readme_summary: CtxPort is a browser extension that allows users to easily copy AI conversations from platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini into clean, structured Markdown format. It prioritizes local processing and privacy, enabling seamless transfer of AI-generated knowledge between different tools and workflows.
key_features: One-click copying of AI conversations
Outputs clean, structured Markdown
Supports multiple AI platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, Doubao, GitHub)
Works offline and with 100% local processing
Zero data upload and minimal permissions
Open source (MIT License)
Manifest V3 compliant
Code Only mode for extracting code snippets
primary_use_case: To facilitate the seamless transfer and organization of AI-generated conversations and knowledge across different AI platforms, editors, and documentation tools by converting them into a clean Markdown format.
cover_image_prompt: A magical, antique book lies open on a wooden desk. From the pages, vibrant streams of text and code are flowing upwards, transforming into clean, organized stacks of neatly bound Markdown documents. A stylized, glowing cursor hovers over the book, representing the one-click action. In the background, subtle outlines of different AI chat interfaces (like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) are visible, suggesting the source of the information. The overall mood is one of effortless knowledge transfer and organization, with a touch of digital magic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette and clear, readable elements.

name: SteamDepotDownloaderGUI
description: 🎮⌛Downgrade Steam games to older versions with ease using DepotDownloader
readme_summary: SteamDepotDownloaderGUI is a cross-platform graphical application that simplifies the process of downloading older versions of Steam games. It acts as a user-friendly interface for the DepotDownloader tool, enabling users to easily select and acquire specific game versions for purposes like speedrunning or restoring previous game states.
key_features: Graphical User Interface (GUI) for DepotDownloader
Cross-platform support (Windows, Linux, macOS)
Easy downloading of older game versions
Tutorials provided for common use cases (e.g., Subnautica downgrade)
Focus on user safety and account security
primary_use_case: To provide a simple, graphical way for users to download and install older versions of Steam games.
cover_image_prompt: A vintage clockmaker meticulously adjusting the gears of a large, ornate clock face that displays different game versions instead of numbers. One hand is pointing to an older, classic version of a game. In the background, a user is shown with a simplified, friendly interface on a screen, selecting a specific 'time' (game version) to download. Digital particles representing game data flow from the clock's mechanism towards the user's screen. The overall mood is one of precision and nostalgia, with a clean, slightly stylized digital art aesthetic. The repository name 'SteamDepotDownloaderGUI' is subtly integrated into the clock's design.

name: lsv
description: A configurable command line file browser with preview and key bindings.
readme_summary: lsv is a terminal-based file browser written in Rust, offering a three-pane interface for navigating parent, current, and preview directories. It is highly configurable via Lua and supports rich previews from external tools, making file management efficient and visually informative within the terminal.
key_features: Three-pane navigation (parent/current/preview)
Keyboard-driven UX with multi-key sequences and which-key overlay
Lua configuration for themes, keymaps, actions, and previewer
External command integration for previews
File operations (add/rename/delete, copy/move/paste)
Marks for saving and jumping to directories
Display modes (hidden files, size/date formats)
Command palette with suggestions and Tab-completion
primary_use_case: Efficiently browsing and managing files within a terminal environment using a multi-pane interface and customizable features.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled cartographer meticulously drawing a detailed map of a complex labyrinth. The cartographer uses a magical quill that draws three distinct paths simultaneously: one showing the entrance (parent directory), another detailing the current maze section (current directory), and a third path highlighting a hidden treasure or point of interest (preview pane). Small, glowing runes representing file types float around the map. The overall scene is set in a cozy, dimly lit study filled with scrolls and ancient tools, with subtle digital elements like glowing data streams flowing from the quill. The style should be a detailed digital painting with a focus on clear visual storytelling and a warm, inviting color palette, emphasizing the 'lsv' name subtly etched on the cartographer's desk.

name: semtools
description: Semantic search and document parsing tools for the command line
readme_summary: SemTools is a high-performance command-line interface (CLI) tool built in Rust for semantic search and document parsing. It allows users to parse various document formats, perform local semantic searches using embeddings, and interact with documents via an AI agent.
key_features: Fast semantic search using model2vec embeddings
Reliable document parsing with caching and error handling
Unix-friendly design with proper stdin/stdout handling
Configurable distance thresholds and returned chunk sizes
Multi-format support for parsing documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, etc.)
Concurrent processing for better parsing performance
Workspace management for efficient document retrieval over large collections
primary_use_case: Command-line semantic search and document processing
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian in a vast, futuristic library, holding a glowing magnifying glass over a stack of diverse documents (PDFs, DOCX). As the magnifying glass focuses, the documents transform into streams of glowing data particles that flow into a central, illuminated AI brain. Subtle UI elements showing search queries and results appear on floating screens around the librarian. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style, with a warm, inviting color palette and a focus on the transformation of raw information into searchable knowledge. The repository name 'SemTools' is subtly etched onto a nearby bookshelf.
